name: Saint Luke the Evangelist
history: A Greek physician and companion of Saint Paul who wrote the third Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles. Only Luke gives us the Annunciation, the Visitation, the Magnificat, the Benedictus, the shepherds, the Prodigal Son and the Good Samaritan. Tradition says he painted the first icon of the Virgin.
meditation: Read Luke 15 slowly today, the lost sheep, the lost coin and the lost son.
prayer: O Lord, we beseech You, that Luke, Your holy Evangelist, who for the honor of Your name bore continually in his body the suffering of the cross, may intercede in our behalf. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
